notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Tooltip at the start to notify players about "Skip Cutscenes" option
[*] Added "Arrow Bells" to assist in level navigation 
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Final Boss Phase 3 not damaging player
[*] Fixed level completion percentage being displayed correctly
[*] Fixed Background not appearing in Final Boss Phase transition
[*] Fixed Spikes not causing damage
[*] Fixed rare crashing when attacking a dead enemy.
[/list]
